entries.title: Entity Stats — CSV export
entries.details: You can now export any Entity Stats table to a CSV file. Covers all entity types: stations, ships, vehicles, facilities, items, weapons, droids, creatures, NPCs, races, terrain, materials, and planets. The export includes all fields with human-readable column headers — linked weapons, raw materials, skills, terrain restrictions, shield arcs, and image URLs are all included.

entries.title: Astrogation upload fix — cursor no longer resets
entries.details: Fixed a bug where your upload cursor (the position SWC events are fetched from) was being silently wiped every time you moved the galaxy map. This caused every upload after any map interaction to re-scan all your travel history from the beginning and report everything as unchanged, even when you had new grids to contribute. Uploads now correctly pick up from where you last left off.

entries.title: Galaxy map — critical fix: map was broken for all users
entries.details: Fixed a crash that was returning a 500 error on every galaxy snapshot request, preventing the Astrogation map from loading at all. An undefined variable in the snapshot metadata endpoint caused the entire map to fail silently.

entries.title: Galaxy map — scouted grids now appear immediately after upload
entries.details: Fixed a bug where scouted grids submitted via DroidBrain syncs, astrogation uploads where all records were already known, or admin pulls never updated the map. The map cache was only refreshed when new grids were created — unchanged or DroidBrain-only changes were invisible until the cache expired. The map now updates correctly after any write.

entries.title: Galaxy map — rescan due flag clears after a fresh visit
entries.details: Fixed a bug where grids imported from the legacy database permanently showed as 'rescan due' on the map even after a member visited them via astrogation. The rescan date is now pushed forward 6 months whenever a fresh visit is recorded, clearing the stale flag.

entries.title: Admin: Astrogation Upload Logs panel
entries.details: A new sysadmin panel under Audit shows the full upload history for all members. Each entry shows events seen, events matched, new grids, updated grids, and unchanged grids. Expandable detail shows exactly which grids triggered a reward, the rule that applied (New DS, New AF, Updated DS 1y+, Updated AF 1y+), and the credit amount — as well as grids that were imported but did not qualify for a reward and why.

entries.title: Admin: Pull Events for Member
entries.details: Sysadmins can now trigger a full SWC event pull for any member directly from the Astrogation Uploads panel. The pull fetches all of the member's travel history from the beginning, bypassing their upload cursor, and runs the full import and reward payment logic. Useful for recovering missed grids or diagnosing stuck uploads without requiring the member to take any action.

entries.title: Admin: Action Log and Member Access Log improvements
entries.details: The Action Log and Member Access Log panels now have a Refresh button so new entries are visible without a full page reload. The Action Log also has a load selector (100, 250, or 500 entries) for reviewing more history at once. Both log tables now scroll horizontally so all columns are reachable on narrower screens.
